name: Repo Triage
description: Conservative LLM maintainer bot for GitHub repos. Proposes closures with evidence and applies only when state is unchanged.
long_description: Inspired by ClawSweeper. Tracks issues and PRs from configured repos in SQLite, runs scheduled LLM reviews against the live source, and lets a separate apply lane close items only when the snapshot has not changed since the proposal.
author: Kernl
